visual_environment.illumination: Deep incandescence rising from below, strongest near the base or interior of forms.
visual_environment.palette: Basalt black against orange, red, and near-white heat.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Shimmering, softened, formless, and thermally unstable.
visual_environment.motion: Convective rise, sag, and slow liquefaction.
visual_environment.density: Dark mass with concentrated luminous zones.
visual_environment.material_effects: Edges soften and bleed into heat; granular marks fuse; luminous accents broaden into thermal glow.

visual_environment.illumination: Cool internal mineral light with precise specular-like accents but no glossy surface sheen.
visual_environment.palette: Cool gray, blue, mineral green, pale crystalline white, and restrained gem-like color.
visual_environment.motion: Growth arrests into facets and ordered internal geometry.
visual_environment.material_effects: Edges sharpen; facets, repeated angles, and crystal boundaries become the most precise marks in the deck.

visual_environment.illumination: Thin bright air and long directional shadows from an exposed high source.
visual_environment.palette: Bleached stone, high-altitude blue, pale mineral tan, and cool shadow.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Exposed, elevated, precarious, and newly visible.
visual_environment.density: Open air above concentrated rising mass.
visual_environment.material_effects: Planes tilt, horizons rise, and previously buried textures become newly crisp under exposure.

visual_environment.illumination: Diffuse open daylight with little dramatic modeling.
visual_environment.palette: Lichen green, oxidized rust, softened gray, soil brown, and chalked pale surfaces.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Exposed, patient, pitted, and continuously revised by air and water.
visual_environment.motion: Slow abrasion, flaking, rounding, and in-place breakdown.
visual_environment.density: Fine surface detail without deep visual crowding.
visual_environment.material_effects: Edges round; surfaces pit and mottle; lichen, oxidation, and granular decay accumulate at exposed faces.

visual_environment.illumination: Cool mobile light reflected through water, cloud, or suspended sediment.
visual_environment.palette: Wet gray, blue, blue-green, suspended tan, and cold white.
visual_environment.motion: Flow, drift, tumble, suspension, and trailing displacement.
visual_environment.density: Material stretches into streams and directional trails.
visual_environment.material_effects: Edges blur in the direction of travel; particles separate from source bodies; repeated marks trace current and velocity.

visual_environment.illumination: Low warm light held close to the ground or sediment surface.
visual_environment.palette: Warm silt, muted gold, clay, quiet water blue, and settled brown.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Calm, horizontal, arriving, and ready to become record.
visual_environment.density: Material gathers low and stratifies rather than remaining suspended.
visual_environment.material_effects: Moving grains resolve into layers; horizontal contacts sharpen; translucent water gives way to matte settled beds.

visual_environment.illumination: Compressed darkness with faint deep glow or reflected mineral light, little open sky.
visual_environment.palette: Deep umber, black, compressed red-brown, muted mineral green, and buried blue-gray.
visual_environment.density: High and close-framed, with weight visibly stacked above.
visual_environment.material_effects: Layers compress; pores close; colors deepen; the frame itself feels like part of the load.

visual_environment.illumination: Dim internal heat and mineral sheen rather than open flame.
visual_environment.palette: Veined green, garnet, deep gray, muted heat-red, and mica-like pale accents.
visual_environment.atmosphere: Contorted, enduring, pressurized, and transformed without melting.
visual_environment.motion: Fold, shear, recrystallization, and slow internal flow.
visual_environment.density: Dense banding and veining with organized deformation.
visual_environment.material_effects: Straight bands fold; grains recrystallize; veins cut and rejoin; surfaces acquire a strain sheen while remaining recognizably solid.
